payload.summary: A new arrangement makes daily life easier almost immediately.
payload.body: A new arrangement makes daily life easier almost immediately. Moon trine Uranus can make flexible hours, shared transport, accessible technology, or a changed household role solve a problem people had started treating as permanent. The relief is the evidence. Keep what makes the day easier and do not rebuild the old restriction just because it is familiar. A good change should reduce strain without asking everyone to live in constant instability.
